 1   UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
 2   SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF NEW YORK
 3   ------------------------------------------x
 4   IN RE: JOHNSON v. NEXUS DYNAMICS CORP.
 5   Case No. 26-CV-0412 (S.D.N.Y.)
 6   ------------------------------------------x
 7   DEPOSITION OF THOMAS WESTON
 8   Taken on June 3, 2026 at 9:30 a.m.
 9   Offices of Marchetti & Associates LLP
10   1200 Commerce Drive, Suite 400, New York
11   APPEARANCES:
12   For the Plaintiff: Diane Marchetti, Esq.
13   For the Defendant: Kevin Hartley, Esq.
14   Court Reporter: Sandra Price, RPR
15   EXAMINATION BY MS. MARCHETTI:
16   Q.   Please state your name for the record.
17   A.   Thomas Edward Weston.
18   Q.   What is your position at Nexus Dynamics?
19   A.   Senior Director of the Cloud
20   Infrastructure Division.
21   Q.   How long have you held that role?
22   A.   Since March of 2019.
23   Q.   Are you familiar with the company's
24   document retention policy?
25   A.   Yes, I am. I helped draft the current

                          Page 2

 1   version of that policy in 2023.
 2   Q.   Describe the retention schedule for
 3   engineering records, please.
 4   A.   Project documentation is retained for
 5   seven years. Routine operational logs are
 6   kept for eighteen months and then purged
 7   on a rolling basis by the archive system.
 8   Q.   Who administers litigation holds at
 9   Nexus Dynamics?
10   A.   The legal operations group issues the
11   hold notices. My division carries out the
12   preservation steps for cloud systems.
13   Q.   When was a hold issued for this case?
14   A.   The litigation hold notice went out to
15   the cloud infrastructure team on September
16   12, 2025.
17   Q.   What does the team do when a notice
18   like that arrives?
19   A.   Automated purges are suspended for the
20   named custodians and the backup snapshots
21   are moved to the legal archive tier.
22   Q.   Is that suspension logged anywhere?
23   A.   Yes. The archive system writes an
24   entry for every suspension and every
25   release. The log is append-only.

                          Page 3

 1   Q.   Turning to backups. How are the cloud
 2   system backups organized?
 3   A.   Nightly incremental snapshots and a
 4   full weekly snapshot, retained on a
 5   ninety-day rotation unless a hold applies.
 6   Q.   Where are the snapshots stored?
 7   A.   In a separate archive account with
 8   restricted access. Two administrators in
 9   my division hold the credentials.
10   Q.   Does the retention policy cover email?
11   A.   Email is managed by corporate IT, not
12   my division. My understanding is that the
13   same hold process applies to mailboxes.
14   Q.   How are employees trained on these
15   procedures?
16   A.   There is an annual compliance module.
17   Completion is tracked by Human Resources
18   and reported to the audit committee.
19   Q.   Did your division complete the 2025
20   module?
21   A.   Yes. Completion for my division was
22   one hundred percent as of October 2025.
23   Q.   Thank you. Let's take a short break.
24   (Recess taken from 10:42 a.m. to
25   10:55 a.m.)

                          Page 4

 1   EXAMINATION BY MR. HARTLEY:
 2   Q.   Mr. Weston, just a few questions. Is
 3   the retention policy you described written
 4   down anywhere?
 5   A.   Yes, it is published on the internal
 6   policy portal as document RET-104.
 7   Q.   And the archive log you mentioned, who
 8   can read it?
 9   A.   Legal operations and the two archive
10   administrators. Read access is logged as
11   well.
12   Q.   Nothing further. Thank you.
13   MS. MARCHETTI: No redirect. We are
14   adjourned.
15   (Deposition concluded at 11:20 a.m.)
